name: ctrlv
description: Windows-style clipboard history popup for GNOME Shell

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc && cp -r metadata.json stylesheet.css schemas dist/ && glib-compile-schemas dist/schemas
scripts.pack: npm run build && gnome-extensions pack dist --force --out-dir=. --extra-source=core --extra-source=shell --extra-source=ui
scripts.deploy: npm run pack && gnome-extensions install --force ctrlv@abulgit.shell-extension.zip && gnome-extensions enable ctrlv@abulgit
